theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (push : ∀ k : ℕ, (Euclid P → Euclid P) → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (homot : ∀ k : ℕ, (Euclid P → Euclid P) → (Euclid P → Euclid P) → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1)), (∀ (k : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), IsCompact E → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) (E) → X ω = 0) → push k (fun x => x) X = X) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), LipschitzWith Λ F → LipschitzWith Λ G → IsCompact E → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) (E) → X ω = 0) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) (E) → Y ω = 0) → push k F (X - Y) = push k F X - push k F Y ∧ homot k F G (X - Y) = homot k F G X - homot k F G Y) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F G F' G' : Euclid P → Euclid P) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), LipschitzWith Λ F → LipschitzWith Λ G → LipschitzWith Λ F' → LipschitzWith Λ G' → IsCompact E → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) (E) → X ω = 0) → EqOn F F' E → EqOn G G' E → push k F X = push k F' X ∧ homot k F G X = homot k F' G' X) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1)), LipschitzWith Λ F → LipschitzWith Λ G → IsCompact E → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity X.boundary → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1))) (E) → X ω = 0) → (push (k + 1) F X).boundary = push k F X.boundary ∧ push (k + 1) G X - push (k + 1) F X - homot k F G X.boundary = (homot (k + 1) F G X).boundary) → ∀ (E : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (φ : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ : ℕ → NNReal) (W : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (D Z : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m), (∀ j, IsCompact (E j)) → (∀ j, E j ⊆ E (j + 1)) → (∀ j, LipschitzWith (Λ j) (φ j)) → (∀ j, 1 ≤ Λ j) → (∀ j, Λ j ≤ Λ (j + 1)) → (∀ j, EqOn (φ (j + 1)) (φ j) (E j)) → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (W j)) → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (D j)) → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Z j)) → (∀ j (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) (E j) → W j ω = 0) → (∀ j (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m)) (E j) → D j ω = 0) → (∀ j (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m)) (E j) → Z j ω = 0) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (W 0).boundary ω = D 0 ω - Z 0 ω) → (∀ j (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m), (W (j + 1)).boundary ω = D (j + 1) ω + Z j ω - Z (j + 1) ω) → (∀ N (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), push (m + 1) (φ j) (W j) ω - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), W j ω - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (homot (m + 1) (fun x => x) (φ j) (W j)).boundary ω = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), homot m (fun x => x) (φ j) (D j) ω - homot m (fun x => x) (φ N) (Z N) ω) ∧ ∀ N (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (push (m + 1) (φ j) (W j)).boundary ω = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), push m (φ j) (D j) ω - push m (φ N) (Z N) ω
